assertions.text: The AI Agent IPC MCP server offers tools register_peer, list_peers, send_message, broadcast, receive_messages, and get_peer_status; receive_messages deletes messages on delivery so each is delivered once.

A Git sidebar shows working changes, staging state, commit graph, branch visualization, and inline diffs per repository, including linked worktrees and submodules, with per-line diff comments submittable to agent panes.
Repository development practice: external pull requests are not accepted and are closed automatically without review; bug reports and feature ideas go through GitHub Issues.
The terminal engine is libghostty (Ghostty v1.3.1) providing Metal GPU-accelerated rendering; the tech stack is Swift 6.2, AppKit, SwiftUI, and XcodeGen.

Calyx is a native macOS terminal for running and supervising coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, Grok, pi) in parallel, with an approval inbox, live status, persistent sessions, and inline diff review.
Calyx exposes panes, commands, captured output, browser tabs, language servers, and peer agents to agents through MCP and a bundled CLI.
An LSP proxy MCP exposes lsp_hover, lsp_definition, lsp_references, lsp_rename, and lsp_diagnostics to agents, keeping servers running in the background and starting the right one per workspace.

Persistent sessions are opt-in daemon-backed terminals that survive app quit and crashes, with a Session Browser, recovery flow, optional on-disk history, and remote sessions via calyx-session on SSH hosts.

Architecture: AppKit handles window/tab/focus management with SwiftUI rendering bridged via NSHostingView; all ghostty C API calls go through a GhosttyFFI enum and @MainActor is enforced on UI and model code.

Cursor click-to-move may be offset on Japanese/full-width text because Ghostty translates clicks into arrow-key steps over terminal cells; Calyx also overrides certain Ghostty config keys for Glass UI.
An Agents Sidebar shows each connected agent as working, blocked, idle, or done, with unread badges, click-to-focus navigation, and expandable subagent rows for CLIs that report them.

Repository development practice: building requires macOS 26+, Xcode 26+, Zig matching ghostty's build.zig.zon, and XcodeGen; clone with submodules, build the GhosttyKit xcframework with zig, then generate the Xcode project and build with xcodebuild.
Command text and output are redacted for known secret patterns (tokens, passwords, API keys, JWTs) before agents can read them, with pending redaction reported via output_pending.
The approval inbox is opt-in via Settings; nothing is automatically approved unless the user separately opts in, and cockpit tools like pane_run and pane_send_keys are approval-gated.
Browser tabs are non-persistent WKWebViews limited to http/https with popups blocked, scriptable via 25 bundled 'calyx browser' commands; the browser server listens on localhost:41840.
